projects.name: BookNook
projects.tagline: Add a book, borrow a book, return a book.
projects.shortDescription: BookNook is a small online library where readers can browse a shared collection, add their own books, borrow a book for 14 days, and return it when done. Each user manages only their own books and borrows, protected by Better Auth and JWT verification.
features: Secure authentication with Better Auth (email/password and Google login)
JWT-protected API verified against the Better Auth JWKS endpoint
Private routes protected by a proxy with redirect back after login
Persistent login on page reload
Home slider built with Swiper.js
New Arrivals section showing the 6 latest books from MongoDB
All Books page with responsive equal-height cards
Book Details page with owner info and Borrow button
Add Book form with imgbb image upload and category select
My Books: edit in a pre-filled modal, delete with confirmation modal
Borrow system with 14-day return date
Duplicate borrow prevention (409 conflict)
My Borrows table with Return Book action
Toast notifications for all success and error messages
Loading spinners
Custom 404 page
Dynamic page titles on every route
Fully responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
Password validation (min 6 chars, uppercase and lowercase)

authFlow: User registers or logs in with Better Auth (email/password or Google)
Proxy checks the session cookie before opening private pages
Client requests a JWT and sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>
Server verifies the token via JWKS (signature, issuer, audience)
Server uses the verified email to return or change only that user's data

apiEndpoints.description: Add a book to the main collection
Add a book (owner email from token)

statusCodes.409: Book already borrowed by this user

prerequisites: BookNook server running locally or deployed
deploymentNotes: Add all environment variables in Vercel with production URLs
Allow Vercel network access in MongoDB Atlas (0.0.0.0/0)
Server CLIENT_URL must exactly match client BETTER_AUTH_URL (no trailing slash)
Redeploy after changing any NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable
futureImprovements: Protect POST /allbooks and the /borrows routes with verifyToken and req.user.email, matching the /my-books pattern

Rich exercise cards: image, muscle-group tags, equipment, duration, calories, rating

Today's Plan and Saved for Later lists via global Context
Duplicate-prevention logic when adding workouts
Live stats on My Plan: total exercises, minutes and calories
Sort By dropdown (Duration, Calories, Rating) with instant re-ordering
Real-time navbar badges for Plan and Saved counts
Toast notifications for add, save, remove and mark-as-done actions
Workout detail page with full specs and instructions
Smooth anchor-scroll from hero CTA to the library
Custom 404 page

projects.name: BazarDor
projects.taglineEn: Prices of essential goods at a glance
projects.shortDescription: BazarDor is a responsive Bangla market-price tracker. It shows the latest prices of rice, pulses, oil, vegetables, fish, meat, dairy and spices across different markets in Bangladesh, with Bengali digits and clear green/red daily change badges.
features: Live price ticker: infinite scrolling marquee with emoji, name, price and up/down change
Risers and fallers: top 6 products whose prices went up and down today
Category pages with price sorting (default, low to high, high to low)
Market-wise details: minimum, maximum and average price with bazaar-by-bazar table (login required)
Secure authentication with Better Auth: email/password, Google and GitHub
Profile management: view profile, update name, sign out
Skeleton loaders for smooth loading
Toast notifications
Custom 404 page
Prices shown in Bengali digits with green/red change badges
Fully responsive on mobile, tablet and desktop
environmentNotes: The name MONGOBD_URL is spelled this way on purpose; it matches the current code in src/lib/auth.ts
deploymentNotes: Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to the production URL
Add Google and GitHub OAuth callback URLs for the production domain
